title: Scientists discover two new species of sea spiders along Canadian coastline
content: So far, scientists have identified more than 1,300 species of sea spiders.

title: South Africa reels from spate of mass shootings that killed 38 people in a week
content: On Saturday night, there were separate mass shootings near South Africa's two largest cities.

title: Trump wants to remove a question about race in the census. We look back at the history
content: The Trump administration wants to stop asking about race and ethnicity on the next U.S. census. Since 1790, the topic has been used to exclude people of color, and, more recently, for inclusion.

title: As Congress debates college sports, athletes-turned-senators have a seat at the table
content: The Protect College Sports Act is on the brink of passing in the Senate, where a handful of former college athletes who are now senators on both sides of the aisle have an extra say in the debate.

title: Ohio governor's race: Ramaswamy and Acton clash in rare Democratic pickup opportunity
content: The Ohio governor's race pits former presidential candidate Vivek Ramaswamy against Democrat Amy Acton, a former state health advisor. Democrats see a chance to win a state that usually votes Republican.

title: Playing 'La Bamba' for an hour? Must be a Mexican fandango!
content: A 300-year-old Mexican musical tradition is finding new life around the world — one sweaty, joyous, all-night fandango at a time.

title: Photos: This may be the most inspirational night school on Earth
content: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.

title: From professor to patient: One man's journey on the frontier of lung cancer treatment
content: Lung cancer is still the top cancer killer, but new developments are shifting what the future might hold for patients.

title: 5 arrested near a U.K. air base used by U.S. on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act
content: Police evacuated homes Sunday near an air base in England used by the U.S. and arrested several men over suspected explosives offenses.

title: These Democrats are making Christianity a centerpiece of their midterm campaigns
content: It's rare for Democrats to make religion a centerpiece of their campaigns. But this midterm election cycle, a number of candidates for Congress are doing just that.
